transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I’m just completely drained. Like, even walking from my car into the clinic felt like too much, and at work even opening the EHR feels like it takes everything I have.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… I have. Once all that energy kind of dropped off, I started feeling really empty most days. Hopeless too, like I already messed up my future in healthcare before it even really got started.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about nine months, I think. Since I kind of crashed after that really high-energy stretch… the depressed and guilty and exhausted feeling has just been there most of the time.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I guess I haven’t been paying attention to that specifically. Most days I’m just trying to get through what I have to do.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find enjoyable?
I’m not totally sure. I don’t think I’ve really checked whether things are enjoyable or not… I’ve mostly just been going through the motions.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that you've tried recently and found you didn't enjoy as much as you used to?

I don’t really know. I can’t think of something I’ve actually tried recently and noticed, like, “I used to like this and now I don’t.” I’ve mostly just been doing what I have to do, so I haven’t really tested it.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to like?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed it one way or the other. I haven’t been doing much just to enjoy it lately, so it’s hard for me to say if I’ve lost interest.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling especially anxious, but I also haven’t been paying close attention to it.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?
Yeah, I think so. I haven’t weighed myself much, but my scrubs have been fitting looser. I just haven’t really wanted food, so I’d skip lunch or dinner and mostly just drink coffee or water.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah. My sleep’s been pretty messed up. For a while I was only getting like two or three hours and still felt wired, like I didn’t need more. But lately it’s different — I’ll wake up before dawn feeling sick with worry, or I’ll sleep half the day and still feel exhausted.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah. People at work mentioned I seemed slowed down, and I could feel it too. Even simple stuff, like putting a blood pressure cuff away or answering someone’s question, was taking me way longer than it normally would.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear?

Yeah… I have. At work I’d hear my name over the clinic speaker, or like a monitor beeping for me, and I’d go check on it. But then nobody else heard it, and there wasn’t a patient calling or anything. It made me feel like I was losing track of what was real.
Have you had any thoughts that you think are not your own or that are not based in reality?

Yeah. I got really convinced that I’d been chosen to fix how the whole clinic was taking care of patients. Like it felt like it was my responsibility, not just an idea.

And even when my supervisor told me I was just an aide in training, I still thought they were trying to stop me or block what I was supposed to do. Looking back, it sounds strange, but at the time it felt completely real.
Have you had periods of feeling really down like this before?
Yeah. After that high-energy period ended, I kind of crashed, and the down part has been going on for about nine months. Mostly feeling depressed, guilty, and just exhausted.
Have you had periods of feeling really down like this before the nine months that just passed?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having anything this bad before. Maybe I had normal low days, but not a long period like this that I can clearly point to.
Have you ever had a period of significant depression like this before in your life?

No, I don’t think so. Not like this. The depressed, guilty, exhausted feeling has been going on for about nine months since I crashed after that high-energy period. Before that, I don’t really remember a period this significant.
Have you had more than one period of feeling depressed like this in your life?
No, I don’t think it’s been more than one. This depressed, guilty, exhausted part has just been this one long stretch, about nine months since I crashed after that high-energy period.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely energetic or irritable and didn't need much sleep?

Yeah. There were days where I felt amazing, like I could do anything, almost unstoppable. But I’d also get really irritated fast—like if someone corrected my documentation or told me to slow down, I’d snap at them like they were insulting me.
Have you had any periods of depression like this before the nine months that just passed?
No, not before this. The depressed, guilty, exhausted feeling has really just been this one stretch—about nine months, after I came down from that high-energy time.
Have you had more than one period of feeling depressed like this in your life before the current episode?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t really point to another separate time before this where I felt depressed like this.
